morphology.look_here_first: Look at the calyx first: the conspicuous white/blue-violet mealy or farinose coating is the fastest separator from Azure Sage.
diagnostic_traits: not rosetted; only cauline opposite leaves

confusers.separator: S. farinacea has the characteristic mealy/farinose calyx; S. azurea has a green normally hairy calyx and a taller, more open flowering axis.
